laws.purpose: The complete collection additionally asks that the installed house become a learning civic caretaker, and Iona continue to contribute after leaving an actually exercised care role. These are chosen future-life purposes, not ordinary service synonyms. Iona consents to branching her experienced life into a home life and a travelling ensemble life, then sharing a selected new experience without ending either. Ordinary house services alone do not satisfy this personal request.
laws.learning: Teaching copies whole disclosed cue→device methods in one operation. Attributed accounts are not firsthand lived episodes. No hidden generalization or experience points.
laws.discovery: All recipes and effects are public. Normal starts with primitive ideas; complete starts with all compound capabilities ready to apply, not with fabricated lives or fulfilled events. Known ideas and methods are inexhaustible.
laws.enactment: An actor must be at the event location and know a method for every cue. All learned methods are used unless context.method selects one. Conflicting outputs for the same cue/device reject; all intermediate outputs are visible. A sequence is one selected operation.
laws.fork: Kinship creates a new consenting person with the actual past/repertoire; future episodes belong only to their participants. No office is automatically duplicated. An inherited past may be empty, but that alone cannot satisfy the shared-useful-past goal.
laws.consent: Iona and her descendants voluntarily accept offered teaching, forks, travel, and full mergers in this fiction. Any can take either itinerary. The ensemble teacher shares methods/accounts but is not Iona. Caretakers accept services in domains they know; a civic caretaker declines out-of-mandate direct instructions.
laws.alternatives: Direct remote teaching, ordinary voluntary role transfer, extra copies, early learning, full sharing and consensual merger remain legal. No named recipe is a goal predicate. A merged life is lawful but is not two simultaneously continuing independent lives.
laws.services: Care-suite must actually be enacted by the current keeper and current house device states must match. It remains usable through an unrelated willing steward. No every-action service continuity is demanded.
laws.civicRequests: A civic caretaker accepts in-mandate resident device requests and declines installer overrides. An ordinary executor accepts either. Requests are actual interventions with visible response; no goal requires making a ceremonial refused request. Learning and future event execution remain essential.
laws.representation: Ensemble and house shades are the same output vocabulary in different contexts. Reusing the score at home produces real device states, not an artist badge. Accounts retain the performer and event; transfer never rewrites them.
laws.operationCount: Discovery, method composition, teaching, fork, travel, role transfer and event enactment each count once when selected and changing state. Automatic cues/responses and queries count zero. Redundant teaching without new method/account rejects.
